ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central regions of both lobes, contrasted by low-intensity black pixels at the trailing edge, lateral tips, and median notch area; approximate visual ratio 65:35.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the central 70% of each lobe. Dense black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and a large triangular cluster at the median notch. High-frequency black speckling/mottling is localized at the inferior transition zone between the white central region and the black notch area on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40 degrees; depth occupies approximately 25% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks are visible, particularly on the inner half of the right lobe trailing edge, with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve profile; concave near the median notch, transitioning to convex toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear marks (rake-like scratches) are visible on the lower-right white region, oriented diagonally from the lower-inner toward the upper-outer quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark linear abrasions on the right lobe; irregular serration pattern on the right lobe trailing edge suggests minor historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive stippled transition zone between the black median notch and the white central lobes, characterized by high-density, small-diameter low-intensity pixel clusters.
